entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER 1 .
T he applicant has filed this third application under Section 439 of Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 22.09.2023 by Police Station STF Bhopal, relating to Crime No.11/2019 for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 272, 273, 120-B of IPC and Section 51, 59 of Food Safety & Standard Act, 2006.
2. It is the submission of learned counsel for applicant that it is a case of bail jump and applicant is suffering confinement since 22.09.2023 and suffered more than four months of incarceration.
Earlier he suffered around one month as pretrial detention.
Therefore, he already suffered sufficient period of incarceration.
Because of medical condition of his daughter on the fateful day he could not appear before the trial Court and arrest warrant has been issued against him.
Now he learnt the lesson hardway and would mend his ways to become better citizen.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.

Upon these grounds, counsel prayed for Deepak Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73467654/
1 grant of bail.
3 .

entities.text: Deepak Shrivastava vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of application.

4 . Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5 .
Considering the above submissions and the reason for absence, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court intends to allow this application but with certain stringent conditions.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court/CJM, Gwalior.
8. A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance and information.
9. Certified Copy as per rules.

(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE Van VANDANA VERMA 2024.01.22 18:38:39 +05'30'
